title: Synthesis of Cu-doped V2O5 thin films with improved optical and CO2 gas sensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,196-207
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07026K, Paper
Open Access

Khaled Abdelkarem, Rana Saad, Mohamed Shaban, Adel M. El Sayed
This study examines sol–gel/spin-coated Cu-doped vanadium oxide (V2O5) thin films and their structural and optical changes, which improve CO2 sensing at ambient temperature.
